user_problem: A proposed summary may double-count entities because measure grain and grouping grain are mismatched.
unique_output: A grain worksheet naming row identity, measure additivity, grouping keys, duplication risks, and safe alternatives.
required_input: Table keys, measure definitions, join relationships, intended grouping, and supplied aggregation rules.
critical_rule: Do not declare a sum safe unless uniqueness or an approved deduplication rule is evidenced in the input.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is join-cardinality-audit; this evaluates aggregation safety after relationships are supplied rather than auditing join cardinality itself.
acceptance_scenario: Input orders has one row per order with total; items has many rows per order; proposed join then sum total by customer. Output flags duplicated totals and proposes aggregating orders before the item join.
